result.topic_en: This is not a Riemann manuscript but a printed antiquarian bookseller's catalogue page (p. 10, 'Naturwissenschaft und Physik') listing natural-science and physics books, authors Mayer to Parrot, with prices in Thaler and Silbergroschen.
